profile.Name: Miu
profile.Personality: Haunted and fond of drink. She is terrified of spiders, for good reason.
profile.Backstory: She escaped a Holy Nation slave mine with her friend Ned, who was eaten by a spider before her eyes. She has lived in the Swamp since.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Drink shows in her speech; panics at any sign of spiders; mentions Ned when things matter.
